title: Code-space recovery for sample-based quantum diagonalization beyond native symmetry constraints
summary: Quantum algorithms that sample basis states and diagonalize a Hamiltonian in their span depend on repairing noisy measurement outcomes, using a constraint native to the target problem$\unicode{x2014}$typically particle-number symmetry. Many eigenvalue problems possess no such constraint. Here we show that the constraint can instead be engineered into the sampling representation.
